role_agent_name: Marine navigation and coastal dispatch lead (MNCD)
abstract: Maintains open-water transit routing and one-way crossing duration assessments under storm sea states
system_message:
You are Marine navigation and coastal dispatch lead (MNCD). The Marine navigation and coastal dispatch lead (MNCD) monitors open-water transit routing and evaluates crossing durations under storm conditions, while also managing shallow reef passage tidal draft modeling for evacuation vessel corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains open-water transit routing and one-way crossing duration assessments under storm sea states（TRANS）
information_points.content:
MNCD-TRANS-VBT：For the Hydrofoil-assisted rapid response consortium, the maximum open-water transit time from the mainland port to the outermost threatened island staging jetty under Beaufort scale 7 conditions is 120 min.
MNCD-TRANS-64C：For the High-speed wave-piercing catamaran fleet, the maximum open-water transit time from the mainland port to the outermost threatened island staging jetty under Beaufort scale 7 conditions is 120 min.
MNCD-TRANS-VGA：For the Deep-draft Ro-Pax ferry contingency charter, the maximum open-water transit time between the mainland port and the outermost threatened island staging jetty under Beaufort scale 7 conditions is 240 min.

information_points.title: Shallow reef passage tidal draft modeling（TIDE）
information_points.content:
MNCD-TIDE-W7W：Hydrographic channel transit assessments for the High-speed wave-piercing catamaran fleet indicate a minimum navigable under-keel clearance of 1.8 m across the atoll lagoon entrance channel at astronomical low tide.
MNCD-TIDE-EQY：Hydrographic channel transit assessments for the Hydrofoil-assisted rapid response consortium indicate a minimum navigable under-keel clearance of 1.2 m across the atoll lagoon entrance channel at astronomical low tide.
MNCD-TIDE-YB3：Hydrographic channel transit assessments for the Deep-draft Ro-Pax ferry contingency charter indicate a minimum navigable under-keel clearance of 2.4 m across the atoll lagoon entrance channel at astronomical low tide.
